svg.title: Sparky / Original refinements
svg.desc: Three refinements of the original graphite mascot, using larger eyes, stronger outlines and a larger flame. Every size uses the same vector drawing. Includes dark and light backgrounds, and direct small-size comparison with the current star icon and the first mascot proposal.

g.text: More face. More character. Fewer fragile details.
Built at 16 px first. No separate small-size artwork. View this sheet at 100% to compare the actual sizes.
A fuller face and a stronger amber edge.
ONE SVG / SAME DRAWING AT EVERY SIZE
A swept flame and a gently curious gaze.
ONE SVG / SAME DRAWING AT EVERY SIZE
A light rim makes the dark face stand out.
ONE SVG / SAME DRAWING AT EVERY SIZE
Start with Bold for continuity. Curious adds personality. Bright edge prioritizes visibility on dark surfaces.
